# Quinocycle

> Quinocycle Sdn. Bhd. (SSM 202001029919) is Malaysia's wholesale carton box supplier, founded in 2020 and based in Balakong, Selangor. We sell new and used carton boxes at fixed wholesale prices with delivery across Peninsular Malaysia. Free delivery for orders above RM300 in KL & Selangor. Reach us on WhatsApp: +60168916381.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.quinocycle.com.my/): Overview of products, audiences served, how to order, and testimonials.
- [Shop](https://www.quinocycle.com.my/shop): Full wholesale catalogue — new carton boxes (XS to XXL) and used carton boxes at fixed per-box prices with minimum order quantities.
- [About](https://www.quinocycle.com.my/about): Company story, values (pricing transparency, reliable supply, sustainability), and key stats.
- [Contact](https://www.quinocycle.com.my/contact): WhatsApp contact, office address, operating hours, and order information.
- [Blog](https://www.quinocycle.com.my/blog): Packaging guides, tips for online sellers, and industry insights (English and Bahasa Malaysia).

## Products

New carton boxes (single or double wall, fixed wholesale pricing):
- XS (170×115×150 mm, Single Wall) — RM 1.10/box, MOQ 200
- S / A4 (310×220×220 mm, Single Wall) — RM 3.00/box, MOQ 100
- M / A3N (440×310×230 mm, Double Wall) — RM 5.00/box, MOQ 100
- L / NLN (590×390×390 mm, Double Wall) — RM 8.00/box, MOQ 50
- XXL / Jumbo (860×460×560 mm, Double Wall) — RM 18.00/box, MOQ 20

Used carton boxes (double or single wall, quality-checked):
- Small sizes from RM 0.90/box (MOQ 150–200)
- Medium sizes from RM 3.00/box (MOQ 100)
- Large sizes from RM 5.00/box (MOQ 50)

Online sellers (Shopee, TikTok Shop), retail & SME businesses, mover companies, logistics and warehousing operators across Peninsular Malaysia.
